title: Aoyagi Toya — Christmas At The Aoyagis'〔Part1〕Side Story (Part 1)

rows.Line: Aoyagi Household - Living Room

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Mom, I'm heading off to practice.

rows.Speaker: Toya's Mother
rows.Line:
Toya, wait.
Do you have a moment before you go?

rows.Speaker: Toya's Mother
rows.Line: Your father will be busy performing during Christmas, so we'll be holding our party early as usual.

rows.Speaker: Toya's Mother
rows.Line: Which is why I'd like you to come home early that day. Would that be possible?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Yes, if we have practice that day, I'll ask the others to see if we can end it early or call it off.

rows.Speaker: Toya's Mother
rows.Line: Wonderful...!

rows.Speaker: Toya's Mother
rows.Line: Then, I'll ask your father after he gets home about when will be best.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Okay.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: By the way, will we all be gathering...?

rows.Speaker: Toya's Mother
rows.Line:
Oh, do you mean your brothers?
No, they'll be busy with their own concert.

rows.Speaker: Toya's Mother
rows.Line: They both sounded very sad when I asked them.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: I see...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (If they did come home, I could tell them all about Dad, Akito and everyone else...)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
I know it may seem it's beneath you.
But that's not how I see it.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: This music is as important to me as classical music is to you.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: I've never wanted to hold on to something so much before...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: And I really want you to understand that... Because you're the one who introduced me to the joy of music.

rows.Speaker: Toya's Father
rows.Line: I... I can't understand what people see in that sort of music...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: That sort of music...?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Dad, were you...?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (He still hasn't fully accepted what I'm doing, but I was able to tell him what I actually want to do with my life...)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (Which means I should be comfortable with telling my brothers about it.)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (And I thought I'd get a chance to this Christmas. Unfortunately, it'll have to wait until another time...)

rows.Speaker: Toya's Mother
rows.Line: While we're on the subject, Toya, is there anything you'd like to eat during our party?

rows.Speaker: Toya's Mother
rows.Line: I'll be roasting a chicken since your father said he'd like some.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: What I'd like to eat...?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: How about that rice gratin with fish you made during our last Christmas party?

rows.Speaker: Toya's Mother
rows.Line: Oh, did you like it that much?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Yes, it was very good and definitely left an impression on me.

rows.Speaker: Toya's Mother
rows.Line: Hehe. I'm glad I decided to take on that challenge. Hearing such a glowing review means it was worth the effort.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Challenge...?

rows.Speaker: Toya's Mother
rows.Line: Yes. I generally avoid intricate dishes since I'm not exactly the best cook out there.

rows.Speaker: Toya's Mother
rows.Line: But your father said I should do just fine as long as I follow the recipe.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: I didn't realize...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
(Follow the recipe...
That sounds like something he'd say.)

rows.Speaker: Toya's Mother
rows.Line: Also, Mrs. Tenma... Tsukasa's mother sent me a video for reference.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (She always goes above and beyond for birthday and Christmas parties... But I guess she works very hard behind the scenes.)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Thank you for always putting in so much effort, Mom. I'll be looking forward to what you make for us this Christmas.

rows.Speaker: Toya's Mother
rows.Line: Yes, I'll do my best to make sure both you and your father smile.

rows.Speaker: Toya's Mother
rows.Line: Oh, I'm also thinking about baking some gingerbread cookies.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Gingerbread cookies?

rows.Speaker: Toya's Mother
rows.Line: Hehe. You and your father both like cookies, no? 'Tis the season, and it'll be another nice challenge for me.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Thank you, Mom.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (The cookies she bakes sometimes get a little burnt, but for some reason, they taste better than any others I've had.)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (I'm very much looking forward to our party now...)
